text:
Maya Chen: Quick UX check on the rotate flow — users keep getting a big red banner even when only renaming a key. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/key-rotate
Samir Patel: That's confusing. We should only surface danger when the old key will actually be revoked. Right now rotate looks equivalent to revoke.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility note: visual banner vs screen readers. Banner is first visually but SRs announce the modal title and CTA. Need an aria-live region for any danger text and proper focus order.
Kevin Liu: Backend can add a `revoke_old_key` flag to the rotate endpoint. Current response looks like: {"rotated": true, "old_key_revoked": false}. We can default the UI toggle to off.
Aria Gomez: Proposed checkbox label: "Also revoke existing key after rotation (recommended if compromised)". Keep unchecked by default but show a 1-line explanation and a help link.
Maya Chen: UX suggestion: primary CTA stays neutral unless revoke is toggled. When toggle on -> show inline compact red summary under the toggle and require a small confirm dialog on submit.
Samir Patel: Copy tweak: change banner from "This will revoke access" to "Revoking the old key immediately prevents services using it from authenticating." Short alert: "Old key stays active unless revoked."
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard flow: focus first input (name), tab through toggle, if toggle checked announce the inline alert via aria-live, escape should close and return focus to the key row.
Kevin Liu: Ops safety: require extra confirmation only when revoke=true to avoid accidental outages. I'll put the API behind a feature flag and add server-side guard.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1310: "Rotate: revoke checkbox + accessible alert + copy updates" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1310
Maya Chen: Thanks — can design & eng lock acceptance criteria before anyone ships changes? Avoid multiple copy rounds. :thumbsup:
